title: Food and Chinese
synopsis: Many simple Chinese words for food actually have other meanings. Learn more through this short story about Little Zhang going on a blind date.

fullText.simplified:
食物与中文

    中国人常说“民以食为天”。通过这句话能看出“吃”在中国人的文化和生活里有着重要的地位。吃什么？什么时候吃？用什么吃？怎么吃？……这些被中国老百姓研究得明明白白的。就连汉语中都有很多跟“吃”有关系的词。快去下边小张的故事里数数有几个词和“吃”有关系吧。
    小张是个三十四岁的小伙子，这些年他一直忙着创业，三十多了还是单身。小张的父母看着身边亲戚朋友家的孩子都能帮忙拿快递了，老两口都要急死了。小张的妈妈问他想找个什么样的女朋友，小张说他想找个跟他有共同话题的，不怕吃苦，能跟他一起打拼的女孩儿。听了小张的要求，他妈妈就行动起来了。他妈妈把身边的朋友，家里的亲戚都通知了一遍，决定要在一个月内给小张找到一个合适的女朋友。
    “皇天不负有心人”，小张三姨的同学家里有个女儿，女孩儿叫小雨，长得不错，比小张小四岁。最重要的是小雨大学学的专业跟小张一样，而且现在做的工作正好能帮到小张。在小张妈妈和三姨的安排下，小张和小雨见了面。他们是在一个咖啡厅见的面。为了让小雨更好地了解自己，理科直男小张居然准备了一大堆资料：个人简历、公司介绍、甚至还带了财务证明。见到小雨后，简单聊了两句，小张就把他准备的东西给了小雨。小雨先愣了几秒，然后拿过资料，一页一页地看了起来。看着看着，小雨的脸就严肃了起来，可能是看得太认真了，她忘了小张还坐在旁边。小雨边看边说：“这谁做的PPT呀，这内容也太水了，一点有用的信息都没有。这版面设计也挺水的，哪儿像IT公司做出来的呀！这个人有10年的IT工作经验，居然连个PPT都做不好，真菜！这要在我们公司，早被炒鱿鱼了。”正在喝咖啡的小张听了小雨的吐槽，被咖啡狠狠地呛了一大口，咳嗽个不停。小雨抬起头，尴尬地笑了笑说：“不好意思，我犯职业病了，我以为我在看简历面试呢。”小张脸红红的，不知道是因为咳的还是因为太丢脸不好意思了。他解释说：“这些资料是我公司的员工做的，这个人是我好朋友的弟弟。我知道他能力一般，但是不好意思告诉他。”小雨一听完小张的话，马上说：“你这么做不对，你现在做老板就不能太面了，要不然公司很难做大做好。哎呀，不好意思，我这个人说话直，你别往心里去啊！”“没事没事，我身边正好需要你这样的人帮我。我还有一些问题，你帮我分析分析……”就这样，他们聊了很长时间。
    后来，小雨成了小张的老婆，小雨也成了小张工作上的好帮手。她用专业知识帮小张筛选出“菜”的员工，改进了很“水”的工作内容，也改变了小张“面”的性格。小张的公司越做越好了。
fullText.traditional:
食物與中文

    中國人常說“民以食為天”。通過這句話能看出“吃”在中國人的文化和生活裡有著重要的地位。吃什麼？什麼時候吃？用什麼吃？怎麼吃？……這些被中國老百姓研究得明明白白的。就連漢語中都有很多跟“吃”有關係的詞。快去下邊小張的故事裡數數有幾個詞和“吃”有關係吧。
    小張是個三十四歲的小伙子，這些年他一直忙著創業，三十多了還是單身。小張的父母看著身邊親戚朋友家的孩子都能幫忙拿快遞了，老兩口都要急死了。小張的媽媽問他想找個什麼樣的女朋友，小張說他想找個跟他有共同話題的，不怕吃苦，能跟他一起打拼的女孩兒。聽了小張的要求，他媽媽就行動起來了。他媽媽把身邊的朋友，家裡的親戚都通知了一遍，決定要在一個月內給小張找到一個合適的女朋友。
    “皇天不負有心人”，小張三姨的同學家裡有個女兒，女孩兒叫小雨，長得不錯，比小張小四歲。最重要的是小雨大學學的專業跟小張一樣，而且現在做的工作正好能幫到小張。在小張媽媽和三姨的安排下，小張和小雨見了面。他們是在一個咖啡廳見的面。為了讓小雨更好地了解自己，理科直男小張居然準備了一大堆資料：個人簡歷、公司介紹、甚至還帶了財務證明。見到小雨後，簡單聊了兩句，小張就把他準備的東西給了小雨。小雨先愣了幾秒，然後拿過資料，一頁一頁地看了起來。看著看著，小雨的臉就嚴肅了起來，可能是看得太認真了，她忘了小張還坐在旁邊。小雨邊看邊說：“這誰做的PPT呀，這內容也太水了，一點有用的信息都沒有。這版面設計也挺水的，哪兒像IT公司做出來的呀！這個人有10年的IT工作經驗，居然連個PPT都做不好，真菜！這要在我們公司，早被炒魷魚了。”正在喝咖啡的小張聽了小雨的吐槽，被咖啡狠狠地嗆了一大口，咳嗽個不停。小雨抬起頭，尷尬地笑了笑說：“不好意思，我犯職業病了，我以為我在看簡歷面試呢。”小張臉紅紅的，不知道是因為咳的還是因為太丟臉不好意思了。他解釋說：“這些資料是我公司的員工做的，這個人是我好朋友的弟弟。我知道他能力一般，但是不好意思告訴他。”小雨一聽完小張的話，馬上說：“你這麼做不對，你現在做老闆就不能太麵了，要不然公司很難做大做好。哎呀，不好意思，我這個人說話直，你別往心裡去啊！”“沒事沒事，我身邊正好需要你這樣的人幫我。我還有一些問題，你幫我分析分析……”就這樣，他們聊了很長時間。
    後來，小雨成了小張的老婆，小雨也成了小張工作上的好幫手。她用專業知識幫小張篩選出“菜”的員工，改進了很“水”的工作內容，也改變了小張“麵”的性格。小張的公司越做越好了。

sentences.english: Little Zhang, who was drinking coffee when he heard Little Yu’s criticism, choked hard on his coffee and began to cough uncontrollably.

sentences.simplified: “不好意思，我犯职业病了，我以为我在看简历面试呢。”
sentences.traditional: “不好意思，我犯職業病了，我以為我在看簡歷面試呢。”
sentences.pinyin: bù hǎo yì si wǒ fàn zhí yè bìng le wǒ yǐ wéi wǒ zài kàn jiǎn lì miàn shì ne
sentences.english: Little Yu looked up, gave an awkward smile, and said, ..

sentences.simplified: 小张脸红红的，不知道是因为咳的还是因为太丢脸不好意思了。
sentences.traditional: 小張臉紅紅的，不知道是因為咳的還是因為太丟臉不好意思了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo zhāng liǎn hóng hóng de bù zhī dào shì yīn wèi ké de hái shi yīn wèi tài diū liǎn bù hǎo yì si le
sentences.english: .. “Sorry, it’s a habit from my job. I thought I was reviewing a resume for an interview.”

sentences.simplified: 他解释说：“这些资料是我公司的员工做的，这个人是我好朋友的弟弟。
sentences.traditional: 他解釋說：“這些資料是我公司的員工做的，這個人是我好朋友的弟弟。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiě shì shuō zhè xiē zī liào shì wǒ gōng sī de yuán gōng zuò de zhè ge rén shì wǒ hǎo péng you de dì di
sentences.english: Little Zhang’s face was red, whether from coughing or from embarrassment, he wasn’t sure.

sentences.simplified: 我知道他能力一般，但是不好意思告诉他。”
sentences.traditional: 我知道他能力一般，但是不好意思告訴他。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào tā néng lì yì bān dàn shì bù hǎo yì si gào su tā
sentences.english: He explained, “These materials were prepared by an employee of my company, who is the younger brother of a good friend of mine.

sentences.simplified: 小雨一听完小张的话，马上说：“你这么做不对，你现在做老板就不能太面了，
sentences.traditional: 小雨一聽完小張的話，馬上說：“你這麼做不對，你現在做老闆就不能太麵了，
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yǔ yì tīng wán xiǎo zhāng de huà mǎ shàng shuō nǐ zhè me zuò bú duì nǐ xiàn zài zuò lǎo bǎn jiù bù néng tài miàn le
sentences.english: I know his abilities are average, but I can’t bring myself to tell him.”

sentences.simplified: 要不然公司很难做大做好。
sentences.traditional: 要不然公司很難做大做好。
sentences.pinyin: yào bù rán gōng sī hěn nán zuò dà zuò hǎo
sentences.english: Upon hearing Little Zhang’s words, Little Yu immediately said, “That’s not right. Now that you’re the boss, you can’t be too soft.

sentences.simplified: 哎呀，不好意思，我这个人说话直，你别往心里去啊！”
sentences.traditional: 哎呀，不好意思，我這個人說話直，你別往心裡去啊！”
sentences.pinyin: āi yā bù hǎo yì si wǒ zhè ge rén shuō huà zhí nǐ bié wǎng xīn li qù a
sentences.english: Otherwise, it will be very difficult for the company to grow and do well.

sentences.simplified: “没事没事，我身边正好需要你这样的人帮我。
sentences.traditional: “沒事沒事，我身邊正好需要你這樣的人幫我。
sentences.pinyin: méi shì méi shì wǒ shēn biān zhèng hǎo xū yào nǐ zhè yàng de rén bāng wǒ
sentences.english: Oh, I’m sorry, I speak very frankly. Don’t take it personally!”

sentences.simplified: 我还有一些问题，你帮我分析分析……”
sentences.traditional: 我還有一些問題，你幫我分析分析……”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hái yǒu yì xiē wèn tí nǐ bāng wǒ fēn xī fēn xī
sentences.english: “It’s all right, it’s all right. I actually need someone like you to help me.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，他们聊了很长时间。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，他們聊了很長時間。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng tā men liáo le hěn cháng shí jiān
sentences.english: I have some more questions. Can you help me think through things …”
Just like that, the two of them talked for a very long time.

sentences.english: Later, Little Yu became Little Zhang’s wife, and she also became a great help in his work.

sentences.simplified: 改进了很“水”的工作内容，也改变了小张“面”的性格。
sentences.traditional: 改進了很“水”的工作內容，也改變了小張“麵”的性格。

sentences.english: She used her professional knowledge to help Little Zhang filter out the incompetent employees, ..

sentence_translations: Food and Chinese
Chinese people often say, “Food is the first necessity of people.”
Through this sentence, we can see that “eating” holds an important position in Chinese culture and life.
What to eat? When to eat? What to eat with? How to eat? … these have been thoroughly studied by the Chinese people.
Even in the Chinese language, there are many words related to “eating”.
Count how many words in Little Zhang’s story below are related to “eating”.
Little Zhang is a 34-year-old young man.
These past few years he has been busy with his own business, and he was still single in his thirties.
Little Zhang’s parents saw that the children in the families of their relatives and friends were already able to help pick up packages.
The old couple were extremely anxious.
Little Zhang’s mother asked him what kind of girlfriend he wanted to find.
Little Zhang said he wanted to find a girl who shared common interests with him, ..
.. wasn’t afraid of hard work, and could strive together with him.
After hearing Little Zhang’s requirements, his mother sprang into action.
His mother notified all her friends and relatives.
She decided that she would find a suitable girlfriend for Little Zhang within a month.
“Heaven helps those who help themselves.”
Little Zhang’s third aunt’s classmate had a daughter. The girl was named Little Yu.
She was quite attractive and was four years younger than Little Zhang.
The most important thing was that Little Yu majored in the same subject as Little Zhang in college, ..
.. and it just so happened that her current job could help Little Zhang.
Following the arrangement of Little Zhang’s mother and his third aunt, Little Zhang and Little Yu met.
They met in a coffee shop.
In order to have Little Yu get to know him better, the nerdy Little Zhang even prepared a large stack of materials:
Personal resume, company profile, he even brought financial statements.
After meeting Little Yu and exchanging a few words, Little Zhang handed her the materials he had prepared.
Little Yu was stunned for a few seconds, then took the materials and started looking through them page by page.
As she read, Little Yu’s face became serious.
She was so engrossed in reading that she forgot Little Zhang was still sitting next to her.
As Little Yu read, she said, “Who made this PowerPoint presentation? The content is so weak. There’s no useful information at all.
The layout design is also pretty poor. It doesn’t look like something an IT company would produce!
This person has 10 years of IT work experience and still can’t make a decent PowerPoint presentation. How incompetent!
If this was at our company, he would’ve been fired long ago.”
Little Zhang, who was drinking coffee when he heard Little Yu’s criticism, choked hard on his coffee and began to cough uncontrollably.
Little Yu looked up, gave an awkward smile, and said, ..
.. “Sorry, it’s a habit from my job. I thought I was reviewing a resume for an interview.”
Little Zhang’s face was red, whether from coughing or from embarrassment, he wasn’t sure.
He explained, “These materials were prepared by an employee of my company, who is the younger brother of a good friend of mine.
I know his abilities are average, but I can’t bring myself to tell him.”
Upon hearing Little Zhang’s words, Little Yu immediately said, “That’s not right. Now that you’re the boss, you can’t be too soft.
Otherwise, it will be very difficult for the company to grow and do well.
Oh, I’m sorry, I speak very frankly. Don’t take it personally!”
“It’s all right, it’s all right. I actually need someone like you to help me.
I have some more questions. Can you help me think through things …”
Just like that, the two of them talked for a very long time.
Later, Little Yu became Little Zhang’s wife, and she also became a great help in his work.
She used her professional knowledge to help Little Zhang filter out the incompetent employees, ..
.. improved the poor work content, and also changed Little Zhang’s soft personality.
Little Zhang’s company is now doing better and better.
